name: agent-stage
description: Agents Office: a card per agent with an animated pixel figure for its role (Team Lead, Planner, Coder, Tester, Reviewer, Researcher, Designer) as robots or a space crew, plus a progress bar above the prompt

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Palette for the header and the progress bar

skin.title: Figures
skin.description: robots: the pixel robots. space-crew: a different spacefarer per role (Commander, Navigator, Engineer, Test pilot, Inspector, Astronomer, Star artist).

robotSize.title: Figure size in the terminal
robotSize.description: bust: head and speech bubble (28 x 9 cells). full: the whole figure (32 x 16 cells). The desktop always shows the whole figure.

backdrop.title: Figure backdrop in the terminal
backdrop.description: skin: the figures' own backdrop (beige for robots, deep space for the crew). terminal: your terminal's own background.

fps.title: Frames per second
fps.description: How often the terminal repaints the progress bar (4-30). Figures step at their own pace.

autoOpenPane.title: Open the pane on start
autoOpenPane.description: Open the Agents Office by itself when the session starts (needs a wide terminal); /stage always opens it
